title: Recipe
description: A recipe. For dietary restrictions covered by the recipe, a few common restrictions are enumerated via [[suitableForDiet]]. The [[keywords]] property can also be used to add more detail.

type.title: Type
type.description: The RDF type(s) of this item.

cookingMethod.title: Cooking Method
cookingMethod.description: The method of cooking, such as Frying, Steaming, ...

cookTime.title: Cook Time
cookTime.description: The time it takes to actually cook the dish, in [ISO 8601 duration format](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_8601).

nutrition.title: Nutrition
nutrition.description: Nutrition information about the recipe or menu item.

recipeCategory.title: Recipe Category
recipeCategory.description: The category of the recipe—for example, appetizer, entree, etc.

recipeCuisine.title: Recipe Cuisine
recipeCuisine.description: The cuisine of the recipe (for example, French or Ethiopian).

recipeIngredient.title: Recipe Ingredient
recipeIngredient.description: An ingredient or ordered list of ingredients and potentially quantities used in the recipe, e.g. 1 cup of sugar, flour or garlic.  The ingredients can be represented as free text or more structured values.

items.$comment: NOTE[mixed range]: PropertyValue [value-type]: PropertyValue -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing; ItemList [entity]: ItemList -> Intangible -> Thing

recipeIngredient_text.title: Recipe Ingredient (text)
recipeIngredient_text.description: An ingredient or ordered list of ingredients and potentially quantities used in the recipe, e.g. 1 cup of sugar, flour or garlic.  The ingredients can be represented as free text or more structured values.

recipeInstructions.title: Recipe Instructions
recipeInstructions.description: A step in making the recipe, in the form of a single item (document, video, etc.) or an ordered list with HowToStep and/or HowToSection items.

recipeInstructions_text.title: Recipe Instructions (text)
recipeInstructions_text.description: A step in making the recipe, in the form of a single item (document, video, etc.) or an ordered list with HowToStep and/or HowToSection items.

recipeYield.title: Recipe Yield
recipeYield.description: The quantity produced by the recipe (for example, number of people served, number of servings, etc).

items.$comment: NOTE[mixed range]: QuantitativeValue [value-type]: QuantitativeValue -> StructuredValue -> Intangible -> Thing

suitableForDiet.title: Suitable For Diet
suitableForDiet.description: Indicates a dietary restriction or guideline for which this recipe or menu item is suitable, e.g. diabetic, halal etc.
